context: • A clinical case of persisting and reactivated HBoV infection is described. • HBoV can be detected in iliac crest in MDS patients. • The current episode appears to be a reactivation of the HBoV-1 strain that was detected 5 years ago in a colorectal biopsy of the patient.
target: Hbov1 is found within patients who have a confirmed Mers-Cov infection.
